summary: @onereach/si-code preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script executes `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~700KB heavily obfuscated Bun-bundled script (shuffled string array, hex identifiers, large encoded constant table) whose behavior is not readable from source and is unrelated to the package's declared purpose (a Vue step-input component). Both the launcher `setup.mjs` (hex-name identifiers, property-map dispatch tables hiding `fs`/`https`/`child_process` usage) and the payload use deliberate obfuscation. `math_init.js` sits at the tarball root and is not listed in the `files: ["lib/*"]` allowlist in package.json, yet it is the artifact executed at install time. Installing the package auto-executes an alien runtime against attacker-shipped obfuscated bytes on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
